title: wolfHSM slot: advertise only supported mechanisms
description: C_GetMechanismList returns the same global g_mechs[] for all slots, including wolfHSM slots. wolfHSM slots only support CKM_RSA_PKCS, CKM_ECDSA, CKM_ECDSA_SHA256, and CKM_ECDH1_DERIVE. Advertising ~22 mechanisms (including DES, AES, HMAC variants) when the backend will return CKR_MECHANISM_INVALID for them is a PKCS#11 spec violation (2.40 s11.8: C_GetMechanismList shall return only mechanisms the token supports). Fix: build per-slot mechanism lists at C_Initialize time based on the backend type, or filter g_mechs[] in C_GetMechanismList by consulting the slot's backend ops struct. wolfHSM backend ops should expose a supported-mechanism bitmask or list.
